title: Claude Code subagent transcripts identify executor briefs and state
what: Subagent hook payloads carry agent_id/agent_type and the main transcript_path; each subagent lives at <dir>/<session>/subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl with a .meta.json holding agentType, toolUseId (the spawning Agent call's tool_use_id) and finished. Plain-string user turns there are the orchestrator's briefs and SendMessage follow-ups.
why: The Agent PreToolUse cannot know the future agent_id, so per-executor scope and overlap checks read these files instead of a session-wide union.
learned: Verified live on 2026-11-26: parallel executors were confined to their own scopes, an overlapping brief was refused while the first executor was still starting (pending spawn keyed by tool_use_id), and finished executors freed their files.
author: reactive-end
